title: Staying Safe in Tanzania: Practical Tips
excerpt: Tanzania is a welcoming country for travellers. Practical tips to stay safe in cities, on safari and on the beach.
body:
Most travellers experience Tanzania as friendly and relaxed. Like anywhere, it helps to take some basic precautions.

## In cities

- Do not show expensive jewellery, phones or cameras unnecessarily.
- Take a taxi after dark rather than walking.
- Keep valuables in the hotel safe.
- Be alert in crowded markets.

## On safari

- Always follow your guide's instructions.
- Never leave the vehicle outside designated areas.
- At camps without fences, walk with an escort after dark.

## On the beach

- Do not leave belongings unattended.
- Be polite but firm with beach sellers ("beach boys") if you are not interested.
- Swim only where it is safe.

## Official advice

Check your government's travel advice before you go. See also our page on [whether Tanzania is safe](/tanzania-safe/).

## Health

See [staying healthy on safari](/blog/safari-health-tips/).
